scripts.build:desktop: npm run build && npm run build -w @jolis-mots/desktop
scripts.start:desktop: npm run build:desktop && npm run start -w @jolis-mots/desktop
scripts.build:android: npm run build && npm run sync -w @jolis-mots/android
scripts.package:desktop: node scripts/maj-donnees.mjs && npm run build:desktop && npm run package -w @jolis-mots/desktop
scripts.package:android: node scripts/maj-donnees.mjs && npm run build:android && npm run apk -w @jolis-mots/android
scripts.package:android:debug: node scripts/maj-donnees.mjs && npm run build:android && npm run apk -w @jolis-mots/android -- --debug
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.import: python -I tools/import/extraire.py vocabulaire.xlsx tools/import/sortie/lignes.json && tsx tools/import/importer.ts
